<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>PipeLab - CPU Pipeline & Performance Mission Control</title>
  
  <!-- Fonts: Manrope & IBM Plex Mono -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  
    <!-- PWA & Native App Meta -->
  <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="icon.svg">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#060913">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="PipeLab Pro">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon.svg">

  <!-- Chart.js 4.4.1 from cdnjs -->
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.js"></script>

  <style>
    :root {
      /* Mission Control Dark Palette */
      --bg: #060913;
      --card-bg: rgba(12, 19, 34, 0.75);
      --card-bg-solid: #0c1322;
      --panel-bg: rgba(16, 26, 46, 0.6);
      --panel-bg-hover: rgba(24, 38, 66, 0.8);
      --border: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      --border-light: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
      --border-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      
      --text: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
      
      --accent: #38bdf8;          /* Electric Cyan */
      --accent-hover: #0ea5e9;
      --accent-glow: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      
      /* Hardware telemetry colors */
      --c-if: #38bdf8;            /* Cyan Blue */
      --c-id: #a855f7;            /* Purple */
      --c-ex: #10b981;            /* Emerald Green */
      --c-mem: #f59e0b;           /* Amber */
      --c-wb: #ec4899;            /* Pink */
      
      --c-stall: #f59e0b;
      --c-flush: #ef4444;
      --c-success: #10b981;
      
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius-md: 10px;
      --radius-lg: 14px;
      
      --font-sans: 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Consolas', monospace;
      
      --shadow-card: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      --shadow-glow: 0 0 20px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      
      --cell-size: 32px;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] {
      --bg: #f8fafc;
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      --card-bg-solid: #ffffff;
      --panel-bg: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.9);
      --panel-bg-hover: #e2e8f0;
      --border: #e2e8f0;
      --border-light: #cbd5e1;
      --border-glow: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2);
      
      --text: #0f172a;
      --text-muted: #64748b;
      --text-dim: #94a3b8;
      
      --accent: #0284c7;
      --accent-hover: #0369a1;
      --accent-glow: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.15);
      
      --c-if: #0284c7;
      --c-id: #7c3aed;
      --c-ex: #059669;
      --c-mem: #d97706;
      --c-wb: #db2777;
      
      --shadow-card: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      background-image: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 50%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.04) 0%, transparent 50%);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Scrollbars */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: transparent;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* Top Command Center Header */
    header {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 12px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .brand-section {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .brand-logo {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #38bdf8, #10b981);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #050811;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    .brand-titles h1 {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .brand-titles .subtitle {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .status-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28);
      color: var(--c-success);
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .status-pulse-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--c-success);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--c-success);
      animation: statusPulse 1.6s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes statusPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }

    /* Center View Navigation Tabs (Keeps screen clean and uncluttered) */
    .view-switcher-bar {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 30px;
      padding: 3px;
    }

    .view-tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .view-tab-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .view-tab-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #050811;
      font-weight: 800;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .header-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .btn {
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      background: var(--panel-bg-hover);
      border-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #050811;
      border-color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 800;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
    }

    .btn-sm {
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    /* Main Grid Layout (Matching Reference Operations Room Screen) */
    .dashboard-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 350px;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 1920px;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1300px) {
      .dashboard-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        padding: 12px;
      }
    }

    /* Realistic Glassmorphic Panels */
    .glass-panel {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
    }

    .glass-panel-header {
      padding: 12px 18px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015);
    }

    .glass-panel-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    /* TOPOLOGY SECTION (Exact visual match to top area of user's image) */
    .topology-container {
      padding: 16px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .topology-overview-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .topology-units-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.3fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1000px) {
      .topology-units-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .unit-card {
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .unit-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .unit-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .unit-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .unit-submodules {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .submodule-box {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 3px;
      padding: 6px 4px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .submodule-box.active {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06);
    }

    /* High-Tech Animated Data Bus Lines */
    .bus-connector-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .bus-line {
      flex: 1;
      height: 2px;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border-light), var(--border-light) 6px, transparent 6px, transparent 12px);
      margin: 0 12px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .bus-line.forwarding-active {
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--c-success), var(--c-success) 6px, transparent 6px, transparent 12px);
      animation: busFlow 1s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes busFlow {
      0% { background-position: 0 0; }
      100% { background-position: 24px 0; }
    }

    /* 5-STAGE PIPELINE SEQUENCE BAR (Matching CI/CD Pipeline row in reference image) */
    .pipeline-sequence-section {
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
    }

    .pipeline-flow-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 950px) {
      .pipeline-flow-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .stage-card {
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 116px;
    }

    .stage-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 2px;
    }

    .stage-card.if::before { background: var(--c-if); }
    .stage-card.id::before { background: var(--c-id); }
    .stage-card.ex::before { background: var(--c-ex); }
    .stage-card.mem::before { background: var(--c-mem); }
    .stage-card.wb::before { background: var(--c-wb); }

    .stage-card.stalled-stage {
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        -45deg,
        rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08),
        rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08) 8px,
        transparent 8px,
        transparent 16px
      );
      border-color: var(--c-stall);
    }

    .stage-card.flushed-stage {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
      border-color: var(--c-flush);
    }

    .stage-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .stage-badge {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .stage-inst {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .stage-inst.empty {
      color: var(--text-dim);
      font-style: italic;
      border-style: dashed;
      background: transparent;
    }

    .stage-details {
      margin-top: auto;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    .stage-detail-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .stage-detail-row span:last-child {
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .forwarding-indicator {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
      color: var(--c-success);
      padding: 2px 4px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      animation: pulse 1.5s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; }
    }

    /* LOWER CONSOLE SPLIT (Matching Terraform execution & Drift detection in reference image) */
    .lower-console-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .lower-console-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Terminal Console */
    .terminal-console {
      background: #04070f;
      border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      height: 220px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .console-header-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      font-size: 10.5px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .log-entry {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 2px 0;
      line-height: 1.4;
      border-left: 2px solid transparent;
      padding-left: 6px;
    }

    .log-entry.stall {
      border-left-color: var(--c-stall);
      color: #fbbf24;
    }

    .log-entry.flush {
      border-left-color: var(--c-flush);
      color: #f87171;
    }

    .log-cycle {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .log-tag {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 1px 4px;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .log-tag.stall { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: var(--c-stall); }
    .log-tag.flush { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: var(--c-flush); }
    .log-tag.info { background: var(--panel-bg); color: var(--text-dim); }

    /* Drift / Status Summary Card (Matching Drift Detection in image) */
    .drift-summary-card {
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 220px;
    }

    .drift-badge {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-success);
    }

    .drift-badge.stalled {
      color: var(--c-stall);
    }

    .drift-badge.flushed {
      color: var(--c-flush);
    }

    .drift-shield-icon {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid var(--c-success);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    /* RIGHT TELEMETRY COLUMN (Matching the exact right sidebar in reference image) */
    .telemetry-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* KPI Mini Cards with Sparkline Waveforms */
    .kpi-cards-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .kpi-card {
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .kpi-label {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .kpi-val {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .kpi-sparkline {
      width: 100%;
      height: 22px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* Resource Utilization Progress Bars */
    .utilization-section {
      padding: 14px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .util-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .util-labels {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .util-labels span:last-child {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .util-bar-track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 5px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .util-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 3px;
      transition: width 0.3s ease;
    }

    /* Circular Radial Donut Gauges (Matching Cluster Status 12 and Workload 45 in image) */
    .radial-gauges-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .radial-card {
      background: var(--panel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .radial-title {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .radial-chart-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 76px;
      height: 76px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .radial-center-val {
      position: absolute;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .radial-legend {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    /* Recent Execution Feed (Matching Recent Deployments in reference image) */
    .recent-feed-section {
      padding: 14px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;

  <script>
    /* =================================================================
       1. PURE JAVASCRIPT PIPELINE ENGINE IMPLEMENTATION

    class Assembler {
      static parse(sourceCode) {
        const lines = sourceCode.split('\n');
        const labels = new Map();
        const rawInstructions = [];
        const errors = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
          const lineNum = i + 1;
          let line = lines[i];

          const commentIdx = line.search(/[#;]/);
          if (commentIdx !== -1) {
            line = line.substring(0, commentIdx);
          }
          line = line.trim();
          if (!line) continue;

          while (true) {
            const colonIdx = line.indexOf(':');
            if (colonIdx === -1) break;

            const labelPart = line.substring(0, colonIdx).trim();
            if (!/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(labelPart)) {
              errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Invalid label name '${labelPart}'`);
              break;
            }
            if (labels.has(labelPart.toUpperCase())) {
              errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Duplicate label '${labelPart}'`);
              break;
            }

            labels.set(labelPart.toUpperCase(), rawInstructions.length);
            line = line.substring(colonIdx + 1).trim();
          }

          if (line) {
            rawInstructions.push({
              lineNum,
              text: line,
              pc: rawInstructions.length
            });
          }
        }

        if (errors.length > 0) {
          return { success: false, errors, instructions: [], labels };
        }

        const instructions = [];
        const REG_REGEX = /^R([0-9]|1[0-5])$/i;

        function parseReg(token, lineNum, fieldName) {
          if (!token) {
            errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Missing register for ${fieldName}`);
            return null;
          }
          const match = token.trim().match(REG_REGEX);
          if (!match) {
            errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Invalid register '${token}'. Expected R0-R15`);
            return null;
          }
          return parseInt(match[1], 10);
        }

        function parseMemOperand(token, lineNum) {
          const memMatch = token.trim().match(/^(-?\d+)\s*\(\s*R([0-9]|1[0-5])\s*\)$/i);
          if (!memMatch) {
            errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Invalid memory operand '${token}'. Expected format: offset(Rs), e.g. 0(R1)`);
            return { offset: 0, rs: null };
          }
          return {
            offset: parseInt(memMatch[1], 10),
            rs: parseInt(memMatch[2], 10)
          };
        }

        for (const raw of rawInstructions) {
          const lineNum = raw.lineNum;
          const pc = raw.pc;
          const text = raw.text;

          const spaceIdx = text.search(/\s/);
          let op = '';
          let argsStr = '';
          if (spaceIdx === -1) {
            op = text.toUpperCase();
            argsStr = '';
          } else {
            op = text.substring(0, spaceIdx).trim().toUpperCase();
            argsStr = text.substring(spaceIdx).trim();
          }

          const args = argsStr ? argsStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim()) : [];

          let parsed = {
            pc,
            lineNum,
            raw: text,
            op,
            rd: null,
            rs: null,
            rt: null,
            imm: null,
            offset: null,
            label: null,
            targetPc: null
          };

          switch (op) {
            case 'ADD':
            case 'SUB':
            case 'AND':
            case 'OR': {
              if (args.length !== 3) {
                errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: ${op} expects 3 arguments: ${op} rd, rs, rt`);
              } else {
                parsed.rd = parseReg(args[0], lineNum, 'rd');
                parsed.rs = parseReg(args[1], lineNum, 'rs');
                parsed.rt = parseReg(args[2], lineNum, 'rt');
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ADDI': {
              if (args.length !== 3) {
                errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: ADDI expects 3 arguments: ADDI rd, rs, imm`);
              } else {
                parsed.rd = parseReg(args[0], lineNum, 'rd');
                parsed.rs = parseReg(args[1], lineNum, 'rs');
                const immVal = parseInt(args[2], 10);
                if (isNaN(immVal)) {
                  errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Invalid immediate value '${args[2]}'`);
                } else {
                  parsed.imm = immVal;
                }
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'LW':
            case 'SW': {
              if (args.length !== 2) {
                errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: ${op} expects 2 arguments: ${op} rt, off(rs)`);
              } else {
                parsed.rt = parseReg(args[0], lineNum, 'rt');
                const mem = parseMemOperand(args[1], lineNum);
                parsed.offset = mem.offset;
                parsed.rs = mem.rs;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'BEQ':
            case 'BNE': {
              if (args.length !== 3) {
                errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: ${op} expects 3 arguments: ${op} rs, rt, label`);
              } else {
                parsed.rs = parseReg(args[0], lineNum, 'rs');
                parsed.rt = parseReg(args[1], lineNum, 'rt');
                const labelTarget = args[2].trim().toUpperCase();
                parsed.label = labelTarget;
                if (!labels.has(labelTarget)) {
                  errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Unknown branch target label '${args[2]}'`);
                } else {
                  parsed.targetPc = labels.get(labelTarget);
                }
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'NOP': {
              break;
            }

            default:
              errors.push(`Line ${lineNum}: Unknown instruction '${op}'`);
              break;
          }

          instructions.push(parsed);
        }

        if (errors.length > 0) {
          return { success: false, errors, instructions: [], labels };
        }

        return { success: true, errors: [], instructions, labels };
      }
    }

    class BranchPredictor {
      constructor(type) {
        this.type = type;
        this.table = new Map();
      }

      predict(pc) {
        switch (this.type) {
          case 'not-taken':
            return false;
          case 'taken':
            return true;
          case '1-bit': {
            if (!this.table.has(pc)) {
              this.table.set(pc, false);
            }
            return this.table.get(pc);
          }
          case '2-bit': {
            if (!this.table.has(pc)) {
              this.table.set(pc, 1);
            }
            const state = this.table.get(pc);
            return state >= 2;
          }
          default:
            return false;
        }
      }

      update(pc, actualTaken) {
        switch (this.type) {
          case '1-bit': {
            this.table.set(pc, actualTaken);
            break;
          }
          case '2-bit': {
            let state = this.table.has(pc) ? this.table.get(pc) : 1;
            if (actualTaken) {
              state = Math.min(3, state + 1);
            } else {
              state = Math.max(0, state - 1);
            }
            this.table.set(pc, state);
            break;
          }
          default:
            break;
        }
      }
    }

    class RISCPipelineEngine {
      constructor(sourceCode, config = {}) {
        this.sourceCode = sourceCode;
        this.forwardingEnabled = config.forwarding !== undefined ? config.forwarding : true;
        this.predictorType = config.predictor || 'not-taken';
        this.clockPeriodNs = config.clockPeriodNs !== undefined ? config.clockPeriodNs : 1.0;

        const assembleResult = Assembler.parse(sourceCode);
        if (!assembleResult.success) {
          throw new Error(assembleResult.errors.join('\n'));
        }
        this.program = assembleResult.instructions;
        this.labels = assembleResult.labels;

        this.predictor = new BranchPredictor(this.predictorType);
        this.reset();
      }

      reset() {
        this.predictor = new BranchPredictor(this.predictorType);
        this.registers = new Array(16).fill(0);
        this.memory = new Array(64);
        for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
          this.memory[i] = 10 * (i + 1);
        }

        this.pc = 0;
        this.cycle = 0;
        this.instructionsRetired = 0;
        this.stallCycles = 0;
        this.flushCycles = 0;
        this.branchCount = 0;
        this.mispredictionCount = 0;
        this.isHalted = false;

        this.latch_ID = null;
        this.latch_EX = null;
        this.latch_MEM = null;
        this.latch_WB = null;
        this.held_IF = null;

        this.dynamicInstructions = [];
        this.dynamicIdCounter = 0;
        this.logs = [];
        this.lastModifiedReg = null;
        this.lastModifiedMem = null;

        this.currentStages = {
          IF: null,
          ID: null,
          EX: null,
          MEM: null,
          WB: null,
          exForwarded: false
        };

        this.historyStack = [];
      }

      _captureSnapshot() {
        return {
          pc: this.pc,
          cycle: this.cycle,
          registers: [...this.registers],
          memory: [...this.memory],
          instructionsRetired: this.instructionsRetired,
          stallCycles: this.stallCycles,
          flushCycles: this.flushCycles,
          branchCount: this.branchCount,
          mispredictionCount: this.mispredictionCount,
          isHalted: this.isHalted,
          latch_ID: this.latch_ID,
          latch_EX: this.latch_EX,
          latch_MEM: this.latch_MEM,
          latch_WB: this.latch_WB,
          held_IF: this.held_IF,
          lastModifiedReg: this.lastModifiedReg,
          lastModifiedMem: this.lastModifiedMem,
          currentStages: { ...this.currentStages },
          logsCount: this.logs.length,
          predictorTable: new Map(this.predictor.table),
          dynamicInstCount: this.dynamicInstructions.length,
          dynamicStates: this.dynamicInstructions.map(d => ({
            id: d.id,
            status: d.status,
            stages: { ...d.stages },
            predictedTaken: d.predictedTaken,
            actualTaken: d.actualTaken,
            valA: d.valA,
            valB: d.valB,
            aluResult: d.aluResult,
            memData: d.memData,
            storeVal: d.storeVal,
            result: d.result,
            dest: d.dest
          }))
        };
      }

      _createDynamicInst(inst, pc) {
        const dyn = {
          id: ++this.dynamicIdCounter,
          inst,
          pc,
          asm: inst.raw,
          lineNum: inst.lineNum,
          stages: {},
          status: 'active',
          predictedTaken: false,
          actualTaken: null,
          valA: 0,
          valB: 0,
          aluResult: 0,
          memData: 0,
          storeVal: 0,
          result: 0,
          dest: null
        };
        this.dynamicInstructions.push(dyn);
        return dyn;
      }

      logEvent(type, message) {
        this.logs.push({
          cycle: this.cycle,
          type,
          message
        });
      }

      step() {
        if (this.isHalted) {
          return false;
        }

        if (!this.historyStack) this.historyStack = [];
        this.historyStack.push(this._captureSnapshot());

        this.cycle++;
        this.lastModifiedReg = null;
        this.lastModifiedMem = null;

        let current_IF = null;

        // 1. IF Stage
        if (this.held_IF !== null) {
          current_IF = this.held_IF;
          current_IF.stages[this.cycle] = 'IF (held)';
        } else if (this.pc >= 0 && this.pc < this.program.length) {
          const inst = this.program[this.pc];
          current_IF = this._createDynamicInst(inst, this.pc);
          current_IF.stages[this.cycle] = 'IF';

          if (inst.op === 'BEQ' || inst.op === 'BNE') {
            const pred = this.predictor.predict(this.pc);
            current_IF.predictedTaken = pred;
            if (pred) {
              this.pc = inst.targetPc;
            } else {
              this.pc = this.pc + 1;
            }
          } else {
            this.pc = this.pc + 1;
          }
        } else {
          current_IF = null;
        }

        const stage_WB = this.latch_WB;
        const stage_MEM = this.latch_MEM;
        const stage_EX = this.latch_EX;
        const stage_ID = this.latch_ID;

        // 2. WB Stage
        if (stage_WB && stage_WB.status === 'active') {
          stage_WB.stages[this.cycle] = 'WB';
          if (stage_WB.dest !== null && stage_WB.dest !== 0) {
            this.registers[stage_WB.dest] = stage_WB.result;
            this.lastModifiedReg = stage_WB.dest;
          }
          this.registers[0] = 0;
          this.instructionsRetired++;
          stage_WB.status = 'retired';
        }

        // 3. MEM Stage
        if (stage_MEM && stage_MEM.status === 'active') {
          stage_MEM.stages[this.cycle] = 'MEM';
          const op = stage_MEM.inst.op;

          if (op === 'LW') {
            const addr = stage_MEM.aluResult;
            if (addr >= 0 && addr < 64) {
              stage_MEM.memData = this.memory[addr];
              stage_MEM.result = stage_MEM.memData;
            } else {
              stage_MEM.memData = 0;
              stage_MEM.result = 0;
              this.logEvent('INFO', `LW address ${addr} out of range (0-63)`);
            }
          } else if (op === 'SW') {
            const addr = stage_MEM.aluResult;
            const val = stage_MEM.storeVal;
            if (addr >= 0 && addr < 64) {
              this.memory[addr] = val;
              this.lastModifiedMem = addr;
            } else {
              this.logEvent('INFO', `SW address ${addr} out of range (0-63)`);
            }
          } else {
            stage_MEM.result = stage_MEM.aluResult;
          }
        }

        // 4. EX Stage
        let branchMispredicted = false;
        let redirectPC = null;
        let exForwarded = false;

        if (stage_EX && stage_EX.status === 'active') {
          stage_EX.stages[this.cycle] = 'EX';
          const inst = stage_EX.inst;

          let valA = 0;
          if (inst.rs !== null) {
            if (inst.rs === 0) {
              valA = 0;
            } else if (this.forwardingEnabled && stage_MEM && stage_MEM.status === 'active' && stage_MEM.dest === inst.rs) {
              valA = stage_MEM.result;
              exForwarded = true;
            } else {
              valA = this.registers[inst.rs];
            }
          }
          stage_EX.valA = valA;

          let valB = 0;
          if (inst.rt !== null) {
            if (inst.rt === 0) {
              valB = 0;
            } else if (this.forwardingEnabled && stage_MEM && stage_MEM.status === 'active' && stage_MEM.dest === inst.rt) {
              valB = stage_MEM.result;
              exForwarded = true;
            } else {
              valB = this.registers[inst.rt];
            }
          }
          stage_EX.valB = valB;

          switch (inst.op) {
            case 'ADD':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA + valB) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rd;
              break;
            case 'SUB':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA - valB) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rd;
              break;
            case 'AND':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA & valB) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rd;
              break;
            case 'OR':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA | valB) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rd;
              break;
            case 'ADDI':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA + inst.imm) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rd;
              break;
            case 'LW':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA + inst.offset) | 0;
              stage_EX.dest = inst.rt;
              break;
            case 'SW':
              stage_EX.aluResult = (valA + inst.offset) | 0;
              stage_EX.storeVal = valB;
              stage_EX.dest = null;
              break;
            case 'BEQ':
            case 'BNE': {
              stage_EX.dest = null;
              this.branchCount++;
              const actualTaken = (inst.op === 'BEQ') ? (valA === valB) : (valA !== valB);
              stage_EX.actualTaken = actualTaken;

              this.predictor.update(stage_EX.pc, actualTaken);

              if (actualTaken !== stage_EX.predictedTaken) {
                branchMispredicted = true;
                this.mispredictionCount++;
                this.flushCycles += 2;

                if (actualTaken) {
                  redirectPC = inst.targetPc;
                } else {
                  redirectPC = stage_EX.pc + 1;
                }

                this.logEvent('FLUSH', `Branch misprediction for '${stage_EX.asm}' (predicted ${stage_EX.predictedTaken ? 'Taken' : 'Not-Taken'}, actual ${actualTaken ? 'Taken' : 'Not-Taken'}). Flushing IF and ID.`);
              }
              break;
            }
            case 'NOP':
              stage_EX.dest = null;
              break;
          }
        }

        // 5. Misprediction Handling
        if (branchMispredicted) {
          if (current_IF && current_IF.status === 'active') {
            current_IF.status = 'flushed';
            current_IF.stages[this.cycle] = '✕';
            current_IF = null;
          }
          if (stage_ID && stage_ID.status === 'active') {
            stage_ID.status = 'flushed';
            stage_ID.stages[this.cycle] = '✕';
          }
          this.held_IF = null;
          this.pc = redirectPC;
        }

        // 6. Hazard Detection in ID
        let stallID = false;
        let stallReason = '';

        if (!branchMispredicted && stage_ID && stage_ID.status === 'active') {
          const inst = stage_ID.inst;
          const neededRegs = [];

          if (inst.rs !== null && inst.rs !== 0) {
            neededRegs.push(inst.rs);
          }
          if (inst.rt !== null && inst.rt !== 0) {
            if (inst.op !== 'LW' && inst.op !== 'ADDI') {
              neededRegs.push(inst.rt);
            }
          }

          if (!this.forwardingEnabled) {
            for (const reg of neededRegs) {
              if (stage_EX && stage_EX.status === 'active' && stage_EX.dest === reg) {
                stallID = true;
                stallReason = `${inst.op} needs R${reg}, produced by ${stage_EX.inst.op} in EX`;
                break;
              }
              if (stage_MEM && stage_MEM.status === 'active' && stage_MEM.dest === reg) {
                stallID = true;
                stallReason = `${inst.op} needs R${reg}, produced by ${stage_MEM.inst.op} in MEM`;
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            for (const reg of neededRegs) {
              if (stage_EX && stage_EX.status === 'active' && stage_EX.inst.op === 'LW' && stage_EX.dest === reg) {
                stallID = true;
                stallReason = `${inst.op} needs R${reg}, produced by LW in EX (load-use hazard)`;
                break;
              }
            }
          }

          if (stallID) {
            this.stallCycles++;
            stage_ID.stages[this.cycle] = 'ID (stall)';
            this.logEvent('STALL', stallReason);
          } else {
            stage_ID.stages[this.cycle] = 'ID';
          }
        }

        this.currentStages = {
          IF: current_IF,
          ID: stage_ID,
          EX: stage_EX,
          MEM: stage_MEM,
          WB: stage_WB,
          exForwarded
        };

        // 7. Advance Latches
        if (branchMispredicted) {
          this.latch_WB = stage_MEM;
          this.latch_MEM = stage_EX;
          this.latch_EX = null;
          this.latch_ID = null;
          this.held_IF = null;
        } else if (stallID) {
          this.latch_WB = stage_MEM;
          this.latch_MEM = stage_EX;
          this.latch_EX = null;
          this.latch_ID = stage_ID;
          this.held_IF = current_IF;
        } else {
          this.latch_WB = stage_MEM;
          this.latch_MEM = stage_EX;
          this.latch_EX = stage_ID;
          this.latch_ID = current_IF;
          this.held_IF = null;
        }

        // 8. Termination Check
        const allStagesEmpty = !this.latch_ID && !this.latch_EX && !this.latch_MEM && !this.latch_WB && !this.held_IF;
        if ((this.pc >= this.program.length && allStagesEmpty) || this.cycle >= 5000) {
          this.isHalted = true;
          if (this.cycle >= 5000) {
            this.logEvent('INFO', '5000-cycle safety limit reached. Terminated.');
          }
          return false;
        }

        return true;
      }

      stepBack() {
        if (!this.historyStack || this.historyStack.length === 0) {
          return false;
        }

        const snap = this.historyStack.pop();
        this.pc = snap.pc;
        this.cycle = snap.cycle;
        this.registers = [...snap.registers];
        this.memory = [...snap.memory];
        this.instructionsRetired = snap.instructionsRetired;
        this.stallCycles = snap.stallCycles;
        this.flushCycles = snap.flushCycles;
        this.branchCount = snap.branchCount;
        this.mispredictionCount = snap.mispredictionCount;
        this.isHalted = snap.isHalted;
        this.latch_ID = snap.latch_ID;
        this.latch_EX = snap.latch_EX;
        this.latch_MEM = snap.latch_MEM;
        this.latch_WB = snap.latch_WB;
        this.held_IF = snap.held_IF;
        this.lastModifiedReg = snap.lastModifiedReg;
        this.lastModifiedMem = snap.lastModifiedMem;
        this.currentStages = snap.currentStages;
        this.logs.length = snap.logsCount;
        this.predictor.table = snap.predictorTable;
        this.dynamicInstructions.length = snap.dynamicInstCount;

        for (let i = 0; i < snap.dynamicStates.length; i++) {
          const ds = snap.dynamicStates[i];
          const d = this.dynamicInstructions[i];
          if (d) {
            d.status = ds.status;
            d.stages = { ...ds.stages };
            d.predictedTaken = ds.predictedTaken;
            d.actualTaken = ds.actualTaken;
            d.valA = ds.valA;
            d.valB = ds.valB;
            d.aluResult = ds.aluResult;
            d.memData = ds.memData;
            d.storeVal = ds.storeVal;
            d.result = ds.result;
            d.dest = ds.dest;
          }
        }

        return true;
      }

      run() {
        while (!this.isHalted) {
          this.step();
        }
      }

      getStats() {
        const cpi = this.instructionsRetired > 0
          ? (this.cycle / this.instructionsRetired)
          : 0;
        const executionTimeNs = this.cycle * this.clockPeriodNs;

        return {
          cycles: this.cycle,
          instructionsRetired: this.instructionsRetired,
          cpi: Number(cpi.toFixed(3)),
          stallCycles: this.stallCycles,
          flushCycles: this.flushCycles,
          branches: this.branchCount,
          mispredictions: this.mispredictionCount,
          executionTimeNs: Number(executionTimeNs.toFixed(2))
        };
      }
    }

    function runComparisonAnalysis() {
      const code = asmEditor.value;
      const clockPeriod = parseFloat(clockPeriodInput.value) || 1.0;

      const configurations = [
        { fwd: true, pred: 'not-taken', name: 'Fwd ON + Not-Taken' },
        { fwd: true, pred: 'taken', name: 'Fwd ON + Always Taken' },
        { fwd: true, pred: '1-bit', name: 'Fwd ON + 1-Bit Dynamic' },
        { fwd: true, pred: '2-bit', name: 'Fwd ON + 2-Bit Saturating' },
        { fwd: false, pred: 'not-taken', name: 'Fwd OFF + Not-Taken' },
        { fwd: false, pred: 'taken', name: 'Fwd OFF + Always Taken' },
        { fwd: false, pred: '1-bit', name: 'Fwd OFF + 1-Bit Dynamic' },
        { fwd: false, pred: '2-bit', name: 'Fwd OFF + 2-Bit Saturating' }
      ];

      const results = [];
      let minCycles = Infinity;
      let fastestConfig = null;

      for (const config of configurations) {
        try {
          const sim = new RISCPipelineEngine(code, {
            forwarding: config.fwd,
            predictor: config.pred,
            clockPeriodNs: clockPeriod
          });
          sim.run();
          const stats = sim.getStats();

          results.push({ config, stats });
          if (stats.cycles < minCycles) {
            minCycles = stats.cycles;
            fastestConfig = config.name;
          }
        } catch (err) {}
      }

      if (results.length === 0) return;

      lastComparisonResults = results;
      renderComparisonTable(results, fastestConfig);
      renderComparisonCharts(results);
    }

       7. SIMULATION EXECUTION & INTERACTION CONTROLS
       ================================================================= */
    function stepSimulation() {
      AudioEngine.tick();
      if (!currentEngine || currentEngine.isHalted) return;
      currentEngine.step();
      updateUI();
    }

    function stepBackSimulation() {
      if (!currentEngine) return;
      if (isPlaying) stopPlaying();
      const ok = currentEngine.stepBack();
      if (ok) updateUI();
    }

    function startPlaying() {
      if (isPlaying || !currentEngine || currentEngine.isHalted) return;
      isPlaying = true;
      playText.textContent = 'Pause';
      playIcon.innerHTML = '❚❚';

      timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (!currentEngine || currentEngine.isHalted) {
          stopPlaying();
          updateUI();
          return;
        }
        stepSimulation();
      }, playSpeedMs);
    }

    function stopPlaying() {
      if (!isPlaying) return;
      isPlaying = false;
      playText.textContent = 'Run';
      playIcon.innerHTML = '►';
      if (timer) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      }
      if (currentEngine) updateUI();
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      if (isPlaying) stopPlaying();
      else startPlaying();
    }

    function finishSimulation() {
      if (!currentEngine || currentEngine.isHalted) return;
      stopPlaying();
      currentEngine.run();
      updateUI();
    }

    const AudioEngine = {
      ctx: null,
      enabled: true,
      init() {
        if (!this.ctx && (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)) {
          this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        }
      },
      beep(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.05, gainVal = 0.08) {
        if (!this.enabled) return;
        try {
          this.init();
          if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
          osc.type = type;
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, this.ctx.currentTime);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gainVal, this.ctx.currentTime);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, this.ctx.currentTime + duration);
          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
          osc.start();
          osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + duration);
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      tick() { this.beep(850, 'sine', 0.03, 0.05); },
      click() { this.beep(1200, 'triangle', 0.02, 0.04); },
      stall() { 
        this.beep(280, 'square', 0.08, 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => this.beep(220, 'square', 0.1, 0.06), 90);
      },
      flush() {
        if (!this.enabled) return;
        try {
          this.init();
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
          osc.type = 'sawtooth';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(450, this.ctx.currentTime);
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(150, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, this.ctx.currentTime);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
          osc.start();
          osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      complete() {
        [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50].forEach((freq, i) => {
          setTimeout(() => this.beep(freq, 'sine', 0.25, 0.08), i * 110);
        });
      },
      toggle() {
        this.enabled = !this.enabled;
        const icon = document.getElementById('audioIcon');
        const text = document.getElementById('audioText');
        const barText = document.getElementById('barAudioStatus');
        if (icon) icon.innerHTML = this.enabled ? '🔊' : '🔇';
        if (text) text.textContent = this.enabled ? 'Sound ON' : 'Sound OFF';
        if (barText) barText.textContent = this.enabled ? 'AUDIO: ON' : 'AUDIO: OFF';
        showToast(this.enabled ? 'Audio Synthesizer Enabled' : 'Audio Synthesizer Muted', 'info');
      }
    };

    // Command Palette UI Handlers
    function initCommandPalette() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('cmdPaletteOverlay');
      const input = document.getElementById('cmdPaletteInput');
      const list = document.getElementById('cmdPaletteList');
      const trigger = document.getElementById('cmdPaletteTrigger');
      let selectedIdx = 0;

      function renderCommands(filter = '') {
        const query = filter.toLowerCase().trim();
        const matches = APP_COMMANDS.filter(cmd => 
          cmd.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
          cmd.category.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          (cmd.shortcut && cmd.shortcut.toLowerCase().includes(query))
        );

        list.innerHTML = '';
        if (matches.length === 0) {
          list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px;">No matching commands</div>';
          return;
        }

        matches.forEach((cmd, idx) => {
          const item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'cmd-item' + (idx === selectedIdx ? ' selected' : '');
          item.innerHTML = '<div><strong>' + cmd.title + '</strong> <span style="font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-left:6px;">[' + cmd.category + ']</span></div>' +
                           (cmd.shortcut ? '<span class="cmd-badge">' + cmd.shortcut + '</span>' : '');
          item.addEventListener('click', () => {
            cmd.action();
            closePalette();
          });
          list.appendChild(item);
        });
      }

      function openPalette() {
        overlay.classList.add('active');
        input.value = '';
        selectedIdx = 0;
        renderCommands();
        setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
      }

      function closePalette() {
        overlay.classList.remove('active');
      }

      if (trigger) trigger.addEventListener('click', openPalette);
      const menuCmd = document.getElementById('menuCmdPalette');
      if (menuCmd) menuCmd.addEventListener('click', openPalette);

      overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === overlay) closePalette();
      });

      input.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        selectedIdx = 0;
        renderCommands(e.target.value);
      });

      input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        const items = list.querySelectorAll('.cmd-item');
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
          renderCommands(input.value);
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
          renderCommands(input.value);
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          const query = input.value.toLowerCase().trim();
          const matches = APP_COMMANDS.filter(cmd => 
            cmd.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
            cmd.category.toLowerCase().includes(query)
          );
          if (matches[selectedIdx]) {
            matches[selectedIdx].action();
            closePalette();
          }
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closePalette();
        }
      });

      window.openCommandPalette = openPalette;
      window.closeCommandPalette = closePalette;
    }

      if (barClockPeriod && clockPeriodInput) barClockPeriod.textContent = clockPeriodInput.value + 'ns';

      if (barEngineStatus && barStatusDot) {
        if (currentEngine.isHalted) {

          barStatusDot.style.background = '#f59e0b';

        }
      }
    }
